mechanisms: Tenant directory authority is a separate active membership bound to the exact current credential revision, root admin/accounts permission and tenant/controlling-partner/actor scope. No existing identity or new partner administrator inherits it.

Explicit local deployment maintenance grants/revokes against reviewed revisions, appends the exact event/projection/receipt and records the maintenance database role. Optional first-run opt-in is atomic; omission preserves old version-1 canonical plan meaning.

Ordinary registration authenticates normally, serializes on the tenant directory lock, checks current authority/grant subsets and binds new execution to reviewed credential and membership revisions. Exact receipt lookup cannot revive authority or execute another registration.

Runtime INSERT on immutable registration triggers a pinned isolated NOLOGIN/non-owner/non-BYPASSRLS function. It validates scope, event, result, fields and reviews before temporarily selecting the new partner/admin context; it restores the source context after creating target identity and event. All scope effects and source receipt commit together.

The runtime retains SELECT-only credentials and authority tables and no direct partner INSERT. The projection writer alone has credential UPDATE privilege for its FOR SHARE lock; it issues no credential UPDATE. Its flags, memberships, ownership and execution settings are checked per scoped operation.

Browser-generated credentials are downloaded before proof-only enrollment; review/key remain frozen during uncertain responses. Validated success clears the old error and exports only workspace IDs. Cookie mutations retain normal same-origin/CSRF checks.
